title: Move the objectstack pin past 3a2d38c6e2 (spec shared chunks) and measure vendor-objectstack under Bundle Analysis, re-baselining the eager-closure ceilings once
body:
Filing gate **③, a follow-up owed by a landed change**: objectstack-ai/objectstack#25748 (merged `3a2d38c6e2`, card objectstack-ai/objectstack#8133). The `domain:spec` seat 2 ACCEPT (`6393800730`, item 8) committed to this card at the merge, because it carries the card's own first done-when, which only objectui can measure. Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` seat 2 (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#18549) · `sunhaolin` · session `session_01PC4NPXPgPmpDRG9DdDnyXT`. ⛔ Not a claim. Grade and routing are objectui triage's.

## What changed upstream

`@objectstack/spec` used to ship one self-contained bundle per entry point (`splitting: false`). A consumer importing several subpaths therefore bundled one copy of every schema they share (`FieldSchema` was defined in 14 published `.mjs` files), and the same symbol reached through two subpaths was two different objects. Since `3a2d38c6e2`, every JS output is **one esbuild module graph with shared chunks** (`dist/chunk-HASH.{mjs,js}`). The `exports` map and the type declarations are unchanged.

The upstream measurement, a local stand-in for the number this card owes: objectui's 256 value imports across 11 subpaths at `a3c0da9`, run through esbuild `bundle` + `minify` + `platform: browser` at gzip level 9. They cost **1,628.4 KB** from the per-entry layout and **603.6 KB** from the new one, about −63%.

## Done when (the upstream card's own)

- objectui's pin moves to an objectstack commit at or past `3a2d38c6e2`. The pin today is `.objectui-sha`-paired `b41ed7f68956`, upstream's record of the pin.
- objectui CI `Bundle Analysis` measures `vendor-objectstack` on that pin **well below 1,575 KB**, and the PR names the number. The reopen comment objectstack-ai/objectstack#8133 `6370298049` measured 1,575.1 KB, against a 1,823.2 KB ceiling.
- The eager-closure ceilings are **re-baselined once**, in that same pin move.

## Notes for the pin move

- **Chunk names are unstable by design.** Import only through the `exports` map. Upstream measured objectui `a3c0da9`: its three `@objectstack/spec/dist/index.{js,mjs}` strings are regex probe inputs in `scripts/__tests__/vite-objectstack-spec-dist.test.ts` (`:481`, `:946`, `:1165`) and `vite-objectstack-client-dist.test.ts:398`, not imports. Re-read them on the pin.
- `scripts/objectstack-pin.mjs` hard-links the package's whole tree, so the chunks travel with it. The `vendor-objectstack` group test matches any file under the package directory, so the chunks group there.

Searched objectstack-ai/objectui for `vendor-objectstack Bundle Analysis spec shared chunks pin`: no open card covers it. **New.**
